description: This file defines an OpikLogger class for logging large language model (LLM) events to an Opik server, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods, and manages payload building, batching, and sending of trace and span data.

classes.name: OpikLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending LLM event traces and spans to an Opik server, supporting both sync and async operations, with batching and payload management.

methods.name: _should_skip_event
methods.description: Checks if an event should be skipped based on the presence of 'standard_logging_object' in kwargs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpikLogger, setting up HTTP clients, configuration variables, and async processing.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a success event, building payloads and sending via the Opik client or queue.

methods.name: _sync_send
methods.description: Sends a batch of data synchronously to the specified URL with given headers.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Synchronously logs a success event, building payloads and sending via the Opik client or HTTP.

methods.name: _submit_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously submits a batch of data to the specified URL.

methods.name: _create_opik_headers
methods.description: Creates headers for Opik API requests based on configuration.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously sends queued log events in batch, splitting into traces and spans.
